standard-dialogue.player: What happened to the old man who used to be the doorman?

standard-dialogue.npc: You mean my father? He went into retirement, I've taken over the family business instead.

standard-dialogue.player: Your father! But you don't look anything like him!

standard-dialogue.npc: No, fortunately for me I inherited my good looks from my mother.

attempting-to-open-the-magic-door.text: If the player has any kind of sacks:

steps.npc: Sorry, we cannot allow you to bring those sacks into the market for security reasons.

attempting-to-open-the-magic-door.npc: You may not pass through this door without paying the trading tax.

attempting-to-open-the-magic-door.player: So how much is the tax?

steps.text: If the player brought a diamond:
Player goes through the Magic door.
If the player did not bring a diamond:

steps.player: I haven't brought my diamonds with me.

steps.npc: Not at all. Those are the rules.

options.text: I haven't brought my diamonds with me.

steps.player: I haven't brought my diamonds with me.

options.text: What do you do with all the diamonds you get?

steps.player: What do you do with all the diamonds you get?

steps.npc: Ever heard of fairylights? Well how do you think we make 'em? First we collect a pile of gems and then we get a spider to spin 'em into a long web, we light the jewels by imbuing each one with a little bit of magic.

steps.player: So you're telling me fairylights are made out of gems?

steps.npc: That's right, how else could we make 'em twinkle so beautifully?

steps.text: You show the certificate to the Gate Keeper.

steps.player: Do you know what these strange marks mean?

steps.npc: That you've been doodelling? If you don't mind I have a job to do, please stop distracting me.

steps.text: You show the certificate to the Gate Keeper.

steps.player: Do you know what these strange marks mean?

steps.npc: No I don't and I'm trying to work here. Please stop distracting me!

gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.player: What are you doing all the way over here? Shouldn't you be at the market door?

gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.npc: Yes, that's my usual spot, but the Godfather said I should be here, so here I am.
Hello, did you just come from the market gates? Are my brothers doing their job well? I do worry that they'll start letting people into the market for free without me being there to supervise them!

gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.speaker: Gate Keeper
gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.text: I'm afraid nobody is allowed in there, orders from the boss.

gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.speaker: Gate Keeper
gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.text: I've received orders to let you through if you want. Good luck.
You squeeze past the thorny vines into a small tunnel.

gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.speaker: Gate Keeper
gatekeeper-near-the-entrance-to-the-tang.text: Be careful in there, there are still some of those baby Tanglefootii around.
